memory_candidates.content: For a bare task relation, the cone-neighbourhood topology N_F (O open iff each w in O has a cone (w)_x inside O) is T1 iff the subset-half of Limit, with no other hypothesis; given nullity R w 0 w the cone-subbasis topology T_F is always finer (an N_F-open set is a union of cones), so T1 for T_F follows by t1Space_antitone without the reflection convention. Probe idiom: define the topology with a `where` block discharging isOpen_inter via a min radius and cone_mono; compare topologies with TopologicalSpace.le_def / le_generateFrom_iff_subset_isOpen; prove equality with TopologicalSpace.ext + funext + propext.

Finite counterexample frames over Fin n: define R by sign cases (x = 0, 0 < x, x < 0), prove R_zero/R_pos/R_neg simp characterizations, then Compositionality reduces after `simp only [R_pos ...]` and `revert w v` to `decide` (Fintype.decidableExistsFintype handles the exists). Membership in an arbitrary Set (Fin n) is not decidable: chase such goals with explicit step lemmas and a `match u with` over the literals instead of decide.
